entry.title: New paper maps four decades of Formosan subterranean termite spread in Alabama

link.title: New paper maps four decades of Formosan subterranean termite spread in Alabama

entry.content:
Our new paper documents four decades of Formosan subterranean termite (Coptotermes formosanus) expansion in Alabama.

The species is now documented in 32 of Alabama’s 67 counties, with inland expansion strongly associated with interstate highways. These records provide a baseline for continued monitoring of this invasive termite in the state.

Read the paper in Urban Ecosystems.
entry.summary: Our new paper documents four decades of Formosan subterranean termite (Coptotermes formosanus) expansion in Alabama.

entry.title: Mizumoto Lab at IUSSI 2026 in Freiburg

link.title: Mizumoto Lab at IUSSI 2026 in Freiburg

entry.content:
The Mizumoto Lab participated in the 20th International Congress of the IUSSI in Freiburg, Germany, with two termite research talks and an organized symposium.

Nobu Mizumoto gave the invited talk “Paired, individual, and collective-decision making by dispersing termites.” Elijah Carroll presented “Nesting biology drives the stability of tandem movement coordination in mating termites.”

H. Li-Byarlay and N. Mizumoto also organized the symposium “From founding to function: early-stage dynamics in the life cycle of social insects,” a four-hour session featuring invited and contributed talks on the early stages of social insect colony life.

entry.title: NSF award supports research on termite collective nest construction

link.title: NSF award supports research on termite collective nest construction

entry.content:
The Mizumoto Lab received an NSF award to study the mechanisms and evolution of collective nest construction in termites.

The project combines comparative behavioral experiments, international fieldwork, video analysis, modeling, and phylogenetic analysis. It will also support two PhD students beginning in Fall 2027.

Learn more about NSF Award 2611846.
entry.summary: The Mizumoto Lab received an NSF award to study the mechanisms and evolution of collective nest construction in termites.
